$orderId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['id', 'status', 'total']) && newData.child('id').isString() && newData.child('total').isNumber() && (newData.child('status').val() == 'confirmed' || newData.child('status').val() == 'preparing' || newData.child('status').val() == 'on_the_way' || newData.child('status').val() == 'delivered')
